figure.caption: A caller receives an item through a service.
figure.description: Caller asks Service to get an item. Service asks Store to read it. Store replies to Service, then Service replies to Caller. Requests are solid and replies dashed; time flows downward.

construction.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Caller
  participant Service
  participant Store
  Caller->>Service: Get item
  Service->>Store: Read item
  Store-->>Service: Item
  Service-->>Caller: Item

interpretation.problem: Explain an item lookup mediated by a service.
interpretation.relationship: Participant positions run left-to-right; message order runs downward.
interpretation.filter: No rough filter: preserve sequence semantics and use an explicit outlining phase.
